assertions.hypotheses: Finite alphabets; no hidden input marker.

evidence.local_proof: Empty-stack deterministic acceptance without endmarker is prefix-free because a successful empty-stack computation has no transition on further input. Final-state DCFL need not be prefix-free (e.g. {a,aa}).

assertions.statement: MAX preserves DCFL.
assertions.hypotheses: No proper accepted extension; includes x∈L condition.

evidence.local_proof_outline: On the same DPDA stack, maintain regular configuration test for reachability of an accepting configuration after a nonempty continuation, plus current acceptance bit. Accept current acceptance and negation of continuation test.
evidence.local_proof: Finite Pop(p,A,q) and Acc(p,A) tables yield an NFA reading configuration stack top-down: successive original-cell pops, then acceptance before next pop, with protected bottom. Any successful path decomposes this way; concatenated witnesses reconstruct a path. Annotate suffix-stack transition relations, updating on push and restoring on pop. Product control with DFA for Sigma+ tests a proper continuation. MAX final predicate is current acceptance AND absence of this continuation, all on the same stack.
